editorial:
Ever feel like you are the only one in your family who actually has a plan? That is exactly how Max Mercer feels. He is a smart 10-year-old who gets left behind during the holidays, but instead of being scared, he is ready for a fight. You will find yourself rooting for him as he tries to protect a fancy heirloom from a couple of clumsy thieves. The whole vibe is very lighthearted and cozy, making it the kind of movie you can just turn your brain off to and enjoy with a big bowl of popcorn.

What really works here are the traps. While it follows a familiar formula, the action is snappy and the pacing keeps you moving. The acting is decent for a family flick, though some of the jokes feel a bit old. If you have kids or just want something easy to watch, you should definitely give this a go.
endingExplained: In the final showdown, Max uses his clever traps to completely outsmart the thieves, leaving them beaten and bruised. The police arrive just in time to arrest the couple and recover the stolen heirloom. Max is finally reunited with his family, who realize they need to pay more attention to him. Everything wraps up with a happy holiday celebration, proving that Max is way tougher than his parents ever realized.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic home invasion comedies and family fun.
